row.notes: Whole body read. entry[0] = control, entry[0x14] (+0xa0) = node handle. If the handle is set, not k_Vm_EmptyNodeHandle, valid (vt+0x20) and its value type id equals type 0x14612bda0, reads the flag byte from the value (vt+0x38): otherwise flags = 0. Calls control vt+0xd0(control, bit1 clear ? 1 : 0, 0), then writes *out_changed = old bit 0 of control byte +0xb XOR its new value (when out is non-NULL), and tail-calls control vt+0xc0(control, bit0 clear ? 1 : 0, 0). Caller Vm_UiTabs_OnMessage runs it at the end for every 16-byte entry in uitc+0xd0..+0xd8 with (entry+8 pointer, 0). (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
